components.name: Quantyra optical fixture system
components.role: Recommended keyed source stand and two-port male cradle; preserved legacy stands, cradle and hood

licenses.scope: Fixture CAD/hardware, meshes, G-code and documentation

compatibility.alignment: Source-facing L/R positions 10 mm apart; withdraw 7.2 mm straight before moving 10 mm laterally and reinserting. Clearance joint without clamp or precision alignment claim.
compatibility.spacers: 25/50/100 mm added stop spacing; cradle/spacer/stand and stacking CAD compatibility passed; physical extension fit untested.
compatibility.hood: Original hood incompatible with extended rig; independent ambient control required. Direct keyed pair hood clearance and withdrawal travel require checking.
compatibility.legacy: 34 mm visual edge-alignment and 32 mm narrow stands remain alternatives; original cradle and hood preserved.

status.physical: User reports revised stand and jig physically fit; no calibrated precision or optical performance established.
limitations: No measured repeatability, clamping or perfect alignment
Ambient shielding and optical performance unvalidated
